domain.extension: ymin_new = ymin_old - 128h; original rows embedded at [128:384]; filler rows = background

params.note: eta/rho = 2 is the ideal sustained-activation total relaxation strength (magnitude estimate only)

geometry.chi_e_rule: ideal disk intersected with Omega1; truncation audit counts ideal-positive cells outside the rectangle; ANY positive-support truncation => GEOMETRY_INVALID (no auto fix)

target.recipe: U*,V* = ub,vb + chi_E * roll(D_shift7 dev, rows -136, cols +86); exact background outside chi_E>0; constructed once at t0; no later script injection/reset

measurement.core_note: local detector replicating project caliber (u > ub + 0.100, 4-connected, >=5 px, own-mask weighted centroid); independent EGS code

records.event_rule: save adjacent full four-field snapshots on first a>theta (D), first a>a* with chi_E>0 (emission/g>0), and first core overlapping the output window

run.note: EGS-T003 continues the T002 QUERY checkpoint to120000 on ECS; WAIT remains the referenced complete control

standby_rules.trigger_indicator: first sample with g_max > 0 (emission active: a > a_star on chi_E > 0)
standby_rules.output_indicator: first sample with any detected core overlapping the output window
standby_rules.judgment: ANY trigger or output indicator => standby FAILED with actual time and saved field; if neither occurs, only claim 'not seen within this finite window' (local0-120000)
standby_rules.lineage_note: cores overlapping the output window are identity-matched to the initial sources so drifted pre-existing cores are transparent

fail_rules.action: save state and STOP (no clipping, no rescue)

core_acceptance.source: same frozen rule as the standard pipeline

notes: both branches share the S06 history (not a uniform background)
the relaxation term uses the OLD g with the OLD u,v (synchronous Euler); the frozen core produces the GS base, then the g increment is added
no external time-varying control; target fixed at t0
prechecks cover numerical-stability necessities only -- not consistency or dynamics validation

T001_wait_diagnostics.note: SAME-condition long WAIT control (ECS); referenced, never rerun

wait_reference.note: complete T001 WAIT trajectory (480000 steps, ECS); same-condition control, NOT rerun

execution.platform: ECS (mandated by the task); tmux background; laptop independence required
execution.budget_note: user available time is >12h; the budget is a cap, not a target -- early wrap-up is expected
execution.phase_state: results/egs/EGS-T003/phase_state.json (atomic; rerun resumes from the first incomplete phase)
execution.heartbeat: progress.json written atomically at every record
execution.atomicity: checkpoints/summaries written to tmp then renamed

validation.purpose: prove real checkpoint resume + one uninterrupted short path agree BEFORE continuing (cross-platform: NOT a bit-level resume claim)

uninterrupted_reference.run: ECS fresh [0 -> 61000] from the registered QUERY initial (light records: scalars+events every100tu, detect at60000/61000, four-field at60000 and61000)

junction_check_at_60000.compare: macOS checkpoint state vs ECS uninterrupted state
junction_check_at_60000.note: expected ~1e-14 from platform rounding; thresholds and identity must remain decidable

lockstep_check_60000_to_61000.method: step BOTH states in parallel for4000 steps, record every100tu
lockstep_check_60000_to_61000.on_fail: STOP the whole task and report (no continuation)

steps.action: resume ckpt_0240000 -> run to 120000 with full records (no re-injection)
f64 dt=0.125 sensitivity from original time0 (same input/physical initial) to the fixed observation time120000; NOT grid convergence; never start fine from the coarse endpoint

steps.when: E region NEVER reached emission activation (e_area==0 all records) and no engineering/identity undecidable
steps.action: alt Da=2e-5: alt WAIT to60000 first (misfire check: D activation/g>0/established output => record misfire and STOP this variant), then alt QUERY to120000
steps.hypothesis_note: aux propagation too slow; success must NOT be auto-attributed to diffusion as the only mechanism

steps.action: any other outcome: classify and wrap with pending/negative results; no geometry/time adjustments, no new branches

stop_rules: non-finite / negative / unexplainable identity mixing / engineering error => stop that branch; a fault is NEVER judged a scientific failure
invisible endpoints or key fields => UNDECIDABLE (missing is not negative)
no two-level device launch; no extra parameter variants

output_candidate_criteria.frozen_from: EGS-TR-v1.0 (registered output window and direction/displacement rules)
all_required: unique NEW core first appears with centroid inside chi_E support (r < r_off)
later its centroid leaves chi_E support (chi_E evaluated at the centroid == 0)
later it enters the fixed output window
direction downward (net cy decrease across the window segment)
denominators and identity (lineage vs initial sources) recorded
output_candidate_criteria.evaluation: from per100tu records (e_region_cores + output_window_cores with lineages); a trigger is NOT a release

observation.per_region_stats: a/r recorded separately for D (chi_D>0), channel (Omega1 minus both disks), E (chi_E>0) -- global r_min is NEVER used as the E-region resource
observation.contamination: lineage ambiguity / mixed cores recorded as contamination, never resolved by fiat
observation.download: summary/diagnostics/necessary checkpoints/key-event pre-post fields returned and hash-verified; large snapshots may stay on ECS with a manifest and paths
